abstract: A 19-year-old man with abnormal findings on his chest X ray was referred to our hospital. A chest computed tomography scan revealed a 57 mm mass in the anterior mediastinum, and percutaneous needle biopsy was performed. Histopathological diagnosis was pure seminoma. Since the serum alphafetoprotein (AFP) level was normal and no abnormal findings were noted in the testis, the patient was diagnosed with mediastinal seminoma [International Germ Cell Consensus Classification (IGCCC) goodrisk group]. After three cycles of chemotherapy with bleomycin/etoposide/cisplatin [BEP], the tumor decreased in size to 32 mm, and a fluorodeoxyglucose-positron emission tomography scan indicated negative tumor findings. After four months, the residual tumor increased in size to 40 mm without any increase in the tumor marker levels. Surgical resection was performed, and the histopathological finding was only mature teratoma. Six months after the operation, there has been no recurrence.
abstract_ja: 胸部X線検査で異常所見を指摘された19歳男性が当院に紹介された。胸部CTで前縦隔に57 mmの腫瘤を認め、経皮的針生検が行われた。病理組織学的診断は純粋セミノーマであった。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は正常で、精巣に異常所見は認められなかったため、縦隔セミノーマ[国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類(IGCCC)の良好リスク群]と診断された。ブレオマイシン/エトポシド/シスプラチン[BEP]による化学療法を3サイクル施行後、腫瘍は32 mmに縮小し、フルオロデオキシグルコース陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では腫瘍陰性と判定された。4か月後、腫瘍マーカー値の上昇はないまま、残存腫瘍は40 mmに増大した。外科的切除が行われ、病理組織学的所見は成熟奇形腫のみであった。術後6か月の時点で再発は認められていない。
